Hello, I hope you’re doing well.

I really love your art style, and I’d love to commission you to draw my OC VTuber design in your style.

I’d like the pose to be similar to this reference:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cQbJliOZblZ7UXpC-fBuXyHDjN28d4HY/view?usp=sharing

The pose can be the same overall, but instead of holding fingers up, my OC would be holding an alcoholic drink, such as a martini or cocktail.
The expression should be bratty and smug, with my OC sticking their tongue out and winking playfully with one eye.

For the scene, I’d like something similar — in the water with a donut ring, but with a warm summer vibe.
The water should feel clear, bright, and tropical, with soft ocean colors in the background.
If possible, I’d also love the body/skin to appear wet, with subtle water droplets and light reflections, to emphasize the water and summer feeling.

This reference shows the kind of mood and colors I like:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Riycx_CGAZIGSh4h8lOGr0Ij5eaY6CdU/view?usp=sharing

(though not this exact angle, since most of it would be covered by my OC).

For the outfit, I’d like only panties, in blue and white, with a bow and ties on the hips, similar to this reference:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E0Cr19uKGPaOX5Aqwf5a4ukF6scbXIxs/view?usp=sharing

Preferably, the colors would match my character’s hair color.

The water float donut ring could be blue with a pink–purple gradient, similar to this reference:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ou9FEiO7zxSXwiMeYCGdn8rK6v1rLD0W/view?usp=sharing

Here are my OC references:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HCgZt0ubIwchWvXLoBttYTsJ_E0gd20h?usp=sharing

Additional OC details:
My OC is an Otokonoko femboy-style boy, with dragon horns, pale skin, and baby-blue hair.
